annual_survey_comparator.coverage_text: The Annual Construction Survey includes national construction establishments which have construction projects in Indonesia.
annual_survey_comparator.establishment_definition_text: The annual-survey explanation defines an establishment as an economic activity unit providing goods/services in a physical building with its own cost structure and production records; documented legal forms include cooperative/partnership/government/private and related forms.

same_year_2006_comparison.comparison_scope: same geography and nominal year, but different statistical operations and not assumed to have identical universe, inclusion rules, or estimation semantics

mechanism_candidate_effect.new_constraint: The independent SE06 construction listing reports 4,504 Sumatera Barat construction establishments in 2006, while the annual construction series reports 2,664*. Therefore the annual-series establishment count cannot be silently equated with the full SE06 construction-establishment listing universe.
mechanism_candidate_effect.remaining_gap: The exact inclusion rules and source frame behind the annual-series count, the 2005 Sumatera Barat qualification composition, old/new survey-frame counts, and period-specific weights remain unrecovered.
